info.description: Section 03 — the abilities orbiting a central photograph. ⚠ THE RING ITSELF IS DESIGN: its radius, the two drawn circles and each node's position are computed by the page. Adding or removing a card re-spaces the ring automatically.

kicker.description: Optional — some pages open the section with a small label, some go straight to the heading.

headingEm.description: The second line of the heading, set in italic. The page puts the line break in.

imageAlt.description: ⚠ NOT REQUIRED, AT THE CLIENT'S INSTRUCTION — a photograph can now be published with nothing here, and it will be silent to a screen reader and to search. Please still write it, and write what the picture SHOWS. If you replace the picture, replace this too: a description left behind describes the wrong image, which no text check can catch.
